performance.verdict: Spend is erratic and leads are invisible — intake gap, not ad failure.

findings.text: lead_drought flag: 0 GHL leads recorded across all 28 days despite 14 Google Ads conversions and 36 GBP calls — CRM intake is broken, not ads.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and has no completed event — with dispatch seat empty since 7/7, speed-to-lead automations may be firing at no one.
Spend is highly erratic: 10 zero-spend days in 28 days, with single-day spikes up to $248.50 — budget pacing is unstable and CPL is incalculable.
3-day signal (Aug 19–21): spend $126.10 vs prior 3 days (Aug 16–18) $150.05 — a modest decline inside a flat 45-day pattern; no directional deterioration, just noise.
GBP surged 100% week-over-week to 116 actions including 36 calls, but 0 of those calls appear in GHL — organic demand exists and is being lost at intake.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake immediately: confirm live owner, test booking bot end-to-end, verify 14 Google conversions and 36 GBP calls are routing to an active seat.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 0 leads captured against 14 Google Ads conversions and 36 GBP calls in the last 28 days. Vivian left 7/7 and the booking bot battle-test (due 7/31) has no completion record — speed-to-lead automations may be firing at an empty seat. Action: confirm who now owns the GHL dispatch seat and their login, run a full end-to-end booking bot test, and verify call routing reaches a live person. Success check: at least 1 GHL opportunity created per confirmed Google conversion within 3 days of this fix, confirmed by 2026-08-25.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget scaling until intake fix (S1) is confirmed working — scale-back-up gate in SOW requires intake ownership resolved first.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend averaged only $43.02/day over the last 7 days with 10 zero-spend days in 28 days, but scaling now would pour money into a broken intake funnel. The SOW scale-back-up gate explicitly requires confirmed intake ownership before raising budgets. Watch: re-evaluate budget levels only after GHL intake is confirmed live and at least 3 consecutive days of lead capture are visible in GHL. Re-check date: 2026-08-25.
